name: Remotion Staggered Spring Text Motion
use_when: A title, hook, caption emphasis, or short phrase should build word by word with polished movement.
CapCut Player-style smooth captions or pop captions need a programmatic Remotion version.
The edit needs spring weight, bounce, or elastic pop rather than a linear fade.
avoid_when: The phrase is too long for staggered reading.
A sensitive or calm scene would be cheapened by bounce.
Another strong zoom, overlay, or transition already carries the attention beat.

timeline_pattern.pattern: phrase_split -> per_word_delay -> spring_progress -> translate_or_scale_and_opacity -> final_readable_hold -> caption_restore_or_clear
timeline_pattern.delay_rule: Use frame - index * delayFrames so each word waits for its own local entrance.
timeline_pattern.spring_rule: Use lower damping for playful pop and higher damping for smoother premium caption movement.
timeline_pattern.readability_rule: The final word should land before the viewer needs to process the next visual.

motion.rule: Motion can lift, pop, or bounce words, but the sentence must remain easier to understand than a plain caption.

keyframe_values.large_title_word_delay: Around 8 frames can work between large title lines or words.
keyframe_values.character_pop_delay: Around 3 frames per character can work for short elastic title words.
keyframe_values.lift_distance: Around 120 px can work for large title lift; reduce for captions or smaller text.
keyframe_values.elastic_start: A low damping spring, around damping 8 and stiffness 140, creates visible overshoot; use restraint for serious content.
keyframe_values.ffmpeg_pop_reference: FFmpeg fontsize pop can start around 70 percent and peak around 100-110 percent, but Remotion transform scale is cleaner for reusable components.

sound.rule: Use a soft pop/tick only on selected emphasis words; continuous captions usually need no SFX.

captions.rule: Use this for designed caption groups or emphasis words after transcript wording, timing, line breaks, and placement are corrected.

color.rule: Accent color should mark the meaning-changing word; avoid adding glow/gradient to every staggered word.

implementation.ffmpeg: Approximate with sequential drawtext overlays and optional fontsize/alpha expressions for simple cases; switch to Remotion for many words or spring motion.
implementation.remotion: Split text into words or characters, delay each element by index, drive transform and opacity with spring progress, and hold the resolved phrase.
implementation.blender: Animate text objects or word groups with staggered action offsets and easing curves.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Compound phrase groups, apply Player 3/pop-style effects after correction, or manually stagger separate word layers.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use Essential Graphics/nests with Transform scale/position presets, or send to AE/Remotion when many word delays are needed.

common_mistakes: Staggering words so far apart that meaning arrives late.
Using elastic pop on every caption line.
Letting overshoot crop letters or leave safe areas.
Adding SFX to continuous captions where speech should dominate.
Animating before fixing line breaks and impact words.
qc: The final word lands before the next visual claim competes.
Overshoot does not crop letters or collide with faces/proof/UI.
Caption wording, timing, and line breaks were corrected before animation.
Pop/tick SFX, if used, lands within 2 frames of the visual entrance and stays below speech.
A plain caption fallback would not be clearer for the same moment.
